page.title: Governance
page.purpose: Keep exposure safe and explainable by surfacing fixed-port compliance, route ownership, and remediation guidance before or after exposure.

priorities.statement: A route cannot be considered ready while its port contract is unclear.
Every finding names the affected scenario, expected contract, and remediation.
Governance actions are separated from ordinary exposure actions.

states.description: Findings, filters, and remediation guidance are visible.
All observed exposed routes comply with the fixed-port contract.
Some scenarios could not be audited while available findings remain visible.
Last findings remain visible during refresh.
Audit failed and identifies the failed source.

claims.statement: Every non-empty governance finding includes the expected fixed-port contract and a concrete remediation path.
